admin.notice.first_run_again: An admin made your first-run bonus available again for this duty.

err.record_move_giving: An item reward of the old character is being given right now. Try again shortly.
err.record_move_has_rows: The new character already has Crimson-Police history.
err.record_move_license: The two characters belong to different players.
err.record_move_new_rows: The new character has runs of its own since the move: the move can't be undone.
err.record_move_off: Move record is switched off (Settings → AdminControl.recordMove).
err.record_move_paying: A payment of the old character is still being made. Resolve it first.
err.record_move_target: The new citizen ID is not a Qbox character.
err.reopen_unknown: That reopen was not found or is already undone.
err.season_not_latest: Only the latest season can be reopened, and only while no newer one exists.
err.season_plan_date: Pick a date in the future, at most a year ahead.
err.season_reopen_late: A season can only be reopened within 24 hours of its end.
err.setting_bounty_none: Keep at least one bounty while the weekly bounty is on.

err.streak_nothing: The streak is not breaking: nothing to forgive.
err.week_empty: Nobody was on that week's board.
err.week_open: That week is not over yet.
err.week_recount: Only the last 4 closed weeks can be recounted.
